description.value: River's Edge Clubhouse is the signature restaurant at Sandpiper Resort, situated alongside the Harrison River in Harrison Mills and widely regarded as one of the Fraser Valley's most scenic destination restaurants. Part of a historic 160-acre golf and lodging resort, it serves a full breakfast and lunch/dinner menu featuring BC farm-fresh ingredients. The riverside clubhouse setting draws golfers, resort guests, and locals alike, making it a notable food stop for cyclists touring the Harrison River valley.

address.value: 14282 Morris Valley Rd. Harrison Mills, BC, Canada V0M 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Sandpiper Resort dine page confirms an active restaurant under the name 'River's Edge Clubhouse' (OSM records it as 'River's Edge Restaurant'), located at 14282 Morris Valley Rd. Harrison Mills, BC — not Chilliwack as the OSM community field suggests. The direct dine phone 604.491.9079 on the dine page matches the OSM number. The menu explicitly mentions gluten-free bread substitution and a meatless avocado option; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
